title: Implementation of an integrated DfX approach for modular high-rise residential construction
summary: Published in the Journal of Civil Engineering and Management, 32(7), 939-972, as corresponding author.
details: The paper 'Implementation of an integrated DfX approach for modular high-rise residential construction', accepted in June 2026, is now published in the Journal of Civil Engineering and Management, 32(7), 939-972, where I am a corresponding author. It presents a lifecycle control framework that coordinates DfMA, DfS, DfU, and DfSu through rules, verification gates, and feedback loops, applied to a 13-story modular residential project in South Korea.

title: Cross-platform framework for semantic BIM-to-XR data exchange in immersive construction informatics
details: A cross-platform framework for semantic BIM-to-XR data exchange in immersive construction informatics, accepted in April 2026, is published in Automation in Construction, 188, 106994. The work extends the BIMUniXchange pipeline toward fully semantic, immersive AEC workflows across Revit, ArchiCAD, and Unity.
